verdict: PASS owner source-dependent NO-GO; no useful actual native EMC proliferation measurement contrast survives this source gate
primary_method_evidence: Sec2.4 uses resection tissue,10%formaldehyde/24h fixation,H&E and unnamed SP/DAB IHC on some specimens; cytoplasmic brown positivity is described. No named nuclear proliferation marker, counted tumour-cell fraction/ROI or mitotic area/count protocol exposed. This does not establish an invalid Ki67 assay; no such assay was named.
schema_evidence: Sole original Table1 is clinical/static imaging schema, caseIDs1–13. No paired proliferation fields. Normalized Ki67/MIB1 variants and mitotic/mitoses presence tests are zero; method/schema reinforce missing data prerequisite rather than literal search being used to prove biological absence.
value: A proposed Ki67 fraction-versus-mitosis comparison is not a new EMC empirical result without actual matched measurements. A generic difference between cycling fraction and mitotic state, or already published grade/prognostic associations elsewhere, cannot supply novelty or practical contribution by themselves. No first-proliferation or complete prior-art survey claim.
strongest_alternatives_retained: Different sections, hot spots, cellularity/field area and nucleus selection can explain any future apparent discordance.
Immune/stromal staining, fixation/antibody/observer differences, biopsy/resection and treatment mixtures need source-specific control.
Ki67 fraction and mitotic counts cannot alone determine cycle duration, quiescence, drug dependency or treatment efficacy.
coverage: All13 source caseIDs retained; no target measurement row selected or excluded after seeing values. Existing imaging source is reused only for pathological method/schema; no imaging hypothesis reopened.
omission_limit: One concrete prior-source eligibility gate. No additional primary/public-corpus retrieval performed or broad assay-absence claim. Any suitable genuinely public matched EMC measurement source remains an opportunity, requiring a useful dated prospective question and full conditions before numbers.
decision_consistency: Owner frozen9 artifacts verified; owner stops at missing actual source prerequisite, preserves uncertainty and does not manufacture another endpoint or numerical pilot.
reopening: Actual public source-linked all-case matched Ki67/MIB1 and mitotic assay records with explicit native EMC identity/ROI/denominator/area/preparation/timing/controls and worthwhile unanswered comparison beyond known pathology; prospective method and independent value challenge before outcomes.
